visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman in a white t-shirt and black cap stands before a wall of white gacha machines in a brightly lit retail environment. She smiles broadly at the camera, gesturing enthusiastically towards a specific machine featuring cat-themed merchandise. (2) Close-up shot of the gacha machine's display card, showing Japanese text and illustrations of various clear cat-shaped containers meant for collecting fur. The woman's hand enters the frame to point at the 400-yen price mark. (3) The woman holds a small, clear cat-shaped plastic charm with a gold-colored cord, displaying it proudly to the camera with an excited facial expression. The background retail machines are slightly blurred, emphasizing the object. (4) The scene transitions to a white-floored indoor home where a hand uses a pink-handled brush to groom a fluffy, light-colored cat. Large amounts of fur accumulate on the bristles against a background with a wooden door. (5) The woman's hands are shown in a macro close-up using a thin tool to push the collected cat fur into the small translucent cat-shaped container, which gradually fills with white material. (6) The completed keychain is held up next to the curious cat's face. A pamphlet showing all six collectible varieties is spread out on the floor to show the full collection set.
